description: To consolidate and demonstrate practical proficiency gained across the semester's courses through supervised term work/laboratory assignments.

syllabus.title: Term Work
syllabus.body: Continuous laboratory/assignment work spanning the semester's courses, evaluated through practical demonstrations, viva-voce and a term work file/report.

outcomes: Demonstrate practical proficiency across the semester's courses.
Develop a habit of continuous, well-documented lab work.
